B2 — the 11 pairs matched by Kokugakuin id

These are the strong-evidence pairs only. Each row is one living shrine item and one 927-register-entry item that claim the same Kokugakuin database id (P13677) — so they are very likely the same shrine described twice.

The other ~40 pairs in the full table were matched by name alone, which is weak here: 227 Japanese shrine labels are shared by ≥10 shrines each, covering ~49% of all 30,257 shrine items. They are deliberately not in this file.

No decision has been made and nothing has been edited. Wikidata editing is locked until 2026-09-18 regardless.
